proof_audit.judgment: Relative local nonsatiation gives weakly preferred cost at least wealth, strict improvement strictly more; summed ownership/transfers, profit maximization and nonnegative-price feasibility contradict a Pareto improvement. Convexity and differentiability unnecessary. Externality is explicitly outside own-bundle preference scope.

Open-convex interior-segment lemma; nearest-point attainment for closed noncompact sets through a bounded minimizing sequence; boundary external points, normalized convergent normals and common pointwise inequality. Separates S from int A without claiming contours are ambient-open.

Convex weak upper contours imply convex strict contours; local nonsatiation puts targets in their closure. Downward resources have nonempty dense ambient interior, force nonnegative nonzero prices, support firm optima and zero-value disposal. Ownership-consistent transfers balance. Only valuation quasiequilibrium follows until cheaper-bundle/accessibility plus relative continuity excludes preferred equal-cost bundles.

Zero-price and zero-wealth example distinguishes genuine quasi support from choice optimality and shows a different price can implement the target. Three nonconvex disposal branches globally analyzed; normalized support requires pc≥1/2 and pc≤1/3. Convexifying changes feasible technology.

Necessary/sufficient common affine Engel slope on a C1 product of open connected income intervals for at least two consumers. Independent income variation is essential; one total-income slice does not suffice. Budget identities, local inferior-good slopes and global zero-income restrictions separated. Stone–Geary family positively aggregates; no generic integrability or normative representation claim.

Finite nonempty electorate, at least three alternatives, every profile of weak orders and weak-order outputs. Almost-to-strong decisiveness constructions preserve outsider ties; all six ordered directions reached with three alternatives, then other alternatives via a hub. Minimal decisive coalition splits into a strict branch or weak reverse branch including equality. Singleton dictatorship constrains strict comparisons only.

Positive-weight global optima are Pareto efficient; Cauchy–Schwarz and max-min resource lower bounds prove all numerical global choices. Individual scale/origin changes do not justify unchanged interpersonal weights. Max-min may retain dominated ties. Odd-voter single-peaked median proof includes coincident peaks and permits cross-side ties, without a strategic extension.

limits: Conditioning on a specified efficient allocation or equilibrium is not a new general existence theorem.
Finite economic checks and auxiliary profiles support but do not replace universal mathematical proofs.
Transfers and convexified plans require the rights/technology explicitly declared; no legal implementation is inferred.
Aggregation is a positive demand restriction; interpersonal welfare and strategic collective choice require additional structure.
No infinite-dimensional welfare, infinite-electorate Arrow, Gibbard–Satterthwaite, generic global representative consumer or empirical dataset is claimed.
Source artifact/preparation evidence is not distributed or required by the four-file runtime.
